Carousel No. 24, September 14th, 2026

What degraded

  • Three claims from the Governor's office
    gov.texas.gov now disallows our research agent host-wide, measured this run against a sources registry that said it served no robots file. The claims had already been fetched in good faith and were dropped rather than published. The directive reaches the deck only through ERCOT restating it.
  • One admitted item's summary
    tx-2026-0157 tripped the first-person gate on the bare I in Helios I. The summary avoids standalone roman numerals. The claims keep the verbatim project names.
  • Frame 6's planned value
    Planned at 14 and corrected to 6, after the art was fixed first and measured. Lifting its art band from 4.4 to 10.7 moved the frame median by 0.0, because 80 per cent of that frame is reserve band and night sky by construction.
  • Six findings carried to the next run
    Two cover and caption adjacencies two judges flagged, frame 5 dropping c4's MAY, frame 9 naming a room and no city, frame 3's absence landing only on frame 2, and the accent running four treatments under a law about the accent.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The audit turned out to be a form, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Ten business days to answer the audit.

The Governor ordered a comprehensive verification and audit of every data center advancing through the interconnection process. The instrument turned out to be a questionnaire. Each of three parties files a notarized attestation. A load entity that can't supply what its provider needs may come off Batch Zero.

Seventeen large loads have finished every ERCOT process and hold no approval to energize. Galaxy's Helios campus in Dickens County holds two of the base load classifications, disclosed by the company to its own shareholders.

Nine frames on what a statewide audit turned out to be.

The notice announcing the classifications names not one load and states no total. Project 59142 carries the commission's review of those processes and anyone can read what is filed in it. Which loads got the questionnaire?

#DickensCounty #BatchZero #Project59142

The machine changed itself

  • No upgrade to the machine was reachable this run

Each reverts on its own commit.

Notes

THE RECORD. Two items admitted, tx-2026-0156, the grid operator's verification questionnaire, and tx-2026-0157, a developer's own account of what a classification did to five of its Texas projects. The docket stands at 135 items and 742 claims. Five movement notes were rewritten from boilerplate into item-specific prose, and tx-2026-0120 was re-verified and stamped: the account answered this run and still carries the sentences quoted from it. One candidate was held rather than admitted. WHAT WAS DROPPED. gov.texas.gov now disallows our research agent host-wide. Measured this run: 403 to the agent, 200 and 822 bytes to a browser, and the robots file names it with a blanket disallow, against a sources registry that said the host serves no robots file. A fact-checker had already fetched three claims from it in good faith before the finding existed. All three were dropped rather than published. The Governor's directive reaches the deck only through the grid operator restating it in its own presentation. TWO THINGS THAT WERE ABOUT TO PUBLISH AND DID NOT. A fabricated email address and a fabricated attachment line were set on frame 2, in the same serif as two verbatim quotations, inside a drawn facsimile of a real market notice, on the frame whose whole argument is what a document does and does not say. No claim in this run carries either. And an unsourced dateline sat on frame 8. Both were found by pixel critics reading the render rather than by any gate, and both came off. TWO RELATIONS REFUSED. A caption candidate put the Caspian project inside Dickens County by adjacency, where the record locates only the Helios campus there and locates Caspian nowhere. It lost on it. The winning candidate asserted that September 17th is the next open meeting, which the calendar feed does not say, and that phrase came out of the caption and out of the closing frame. THE DEFECT WORTH KEEPING. The cover shipped its first cut with its one human figure projected off the left edge of the frame, and six gates and a pixel critic all passed it, because every one of them measures what is inside the declared rect and none asks whether what the plan named is inside it at all. Two of three scoring judges found it independently, on three frames at once. The first repair then broke the thing the frame exists for, putting her nine metres in front of a building at thirty so a sixteen metre wall read as three and a half. Three scoring rounds closed it.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
